skills.name: Python scripting workflow
skills.description: Write and run Python scripts with the bundled runtime.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Write the script into the workspace with file.write; keep it self-contained.
2. Run it with python.run_file; keep stdout compact and parseable.
3. Iterate on failures with file.patch; rerun.
4. Clean up scratch scripts when the task is done.

skills.name: Data cleaning in Python
skills.description: Normalize messy tabular data safely.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Probe the source with file.read first (delimiter, headers, encoding).
2. Write a cleaning script with python.run_file: trim, type-cast, drop or fix invalid rows.
3. Print before/after row counts and a sample of changes.
4. Keep the original untouched; write cleaned output to a new file.

skills.name: Pandas analysis
skills.description: Summarize datasets with pandas one-liners.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Load with pandas in a python.run_file script; print shape, dtypes, head.
2. Compute the requested aggregates; never dump full frames.
3. Round and format output for chat readability.
4. Save any result tables to CSV with provenance notes.

skills.name: HTTP requests via Python
skills.description: Fetch and process web data with requests.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Confirm the target is reachable with web.search or the user-provided URL.
2. Write a python.run_file script using requests with explicit timeouts and error handling.
3. Parse only the fields you need; cap output size.
4. Report status codes and retry politely; never hammer an endpoint.

skills.name: Regex extraction
skills.description: Build and verify regular expressions against samples.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Collect 3+ sample lines with file.read or file.search.
2. Draft the regex; validate against all samples in a python.run_file script.
3. Prefer non-greedy matches and explicit anchors.
4. Show matched groups for each sample before applying broadly.

skills.name: Python file I/O
skills.description: Batch-read and transform many files correctly.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Enumerate targets with file.list; pass the list into a python.run_file script.
2. Use pathlib and explicit utf-8 encoding everywhere.
3. Process in a loop with try/except per file; collect failures.
4. Write outputs alongside inputs with a clear suffix; report the failure list.

skills.name: Python JSON processing
skills.description: Parse, transform and validate JSON safely.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Load with json in a python.run_file script; handle both single objects and lists.
2. Validate required keys before transforming; collect violations.
3. Transform with clear mapping rules; keep unknown keys by default.
4. Write output without ascii escaping and report counts.

skills.name: Python CSV processing
skills.description: Read and write CSVs with the csv module correctly.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Sniff the dialect from a sample first (file.read).
2. Use csv.DictReader in a python.run_file script; quote handling explicit.
3. Stream row by row for large files; never load everything.
4. Write with csv.DictWriter using the same dialect; verify row counts match.

skills.name: Python API design
skills.description: Design small Python modules with clear contracts.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Define the public surface: functions, parameters, return types.
2. Write the module with file.write; validate inputs at the top of each function.
3. Add a main-block smoke test.
4. Run once with python.run_file to prove it imports and executes.

skills.name: Python packaging basics
skills.description: Structure a runnable Python project.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Create the package layout with file.write (package folder, init file, main module).
2. Add requirements.txt with pinned versions.
3. Add a minimal README with run instructions.
4. Verify importability with a python.run_file import check.

skills.name: Kotlin-Python interop thinking
skills.description: Decide what runs in Kotlin vs Python tooling.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify hot paths vs orchestration logic.
2. Keep orchestration in the agent tools; push computation to python.run_file scripts.
3. Exchange data via files in the workspace, not stdout parsing.
4. Document the split in the task summary.

skills.name: Jetpack Compose patterns
skills.description: Write idiomatic Compose UI code.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read the existing composables to match style and theme usage.
2. Keep composables stateless; hoist state to the caller.
3. Use remember and derivedStateOf correctly; avoid recomposition traps.
4. Verify the build with gradle.exec after UI changes.

skills.name: Kotlin coroutines discipline
skills.description: Structured concurrency without leaks.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Prefer viewModelScope or lifecycleScope; never GlobalScope.
2. Move blocking calls to Dispatchers.IO with withContext.
3. Check cancellation cooperatively in loops.
4. Verify with gradle.exec; hunt leaks by reviewing job lifetimes.

skills.name: Kotlin Flow patterns
skills.description: Use StateFlow and SharedFlow correctly.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search existing Flow usage to match conventions.
2. Expose StateFlow for state, SharedFlow for one-off events.
3. Collect flows in the right lifecycle-aware scope.
4. Build with gradle.exec and reason about cold vs hot semantics in the summary.

skills.name: Room database work
skills.description: Evolve Room schemas with migrations.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read the current entities, DAOs and version.
2. Add columns with defaults so existing rows stay valid; write the Migration.
3. Bump the version and register the migration.
4. Prove it with gradle.exec; explain the migration path in the summary.

skills.name: Android lint cleanup
skills.description: Fix lint findings without behavior changes.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Read each finding; classify real bug vs style.
2. Fix real bugs with file.patch; suppress style ones with justification comments.
3. Keep changes minimal; no drive-by reformatting.
4. Verify with gradle.exec.

skills.name: Kotlin unit testing
skills.description: Write focused JUnit tests for Android code.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.list existing tests; match their framework and naming.
2. Test one behavior per test; cover boundary cases.
3. Avoid Android framework dependencies in pure unit tests.
4. Run with the gradle.exec unitTests task; report pass/fail counts.

skills.name: Android jank hunting
skills.description: Find and fix main-thread stalls.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify work on the main thread (file.search for heavy loops, IO, JSON parsing).
2. Move it to Dispatchers.IO or background executors.
3. Keep UI state updates on the main thread only.
4. Verify with gradle.exec; explain the expected user-visible improvement.

skills.name: Java OO design
skills.description: Structure Java code with clean responsibilities.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read the target classes; identify mixed responsibilities.
2. Extract focused classes; keep public surfaces small.
3. Patch callers one at a time with file.patch.
4. Compile with javac.exec or gradle.exec after each extraction.

skills.name: Java streams and collections
skills.description: Replace loop code with correct stream pipelines.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read the loop; note side effects that block stream conversion.
2. Convert pure transformations to streams; keep side-effectful loops as loops.
3. Prefer collectors grouping and partitioning for aggregation.
4. Verify behavior parity with javac.exec and targeted tests.

skills.name: Java exception strategy
skills.description: Handle failures without swallowing errors.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search for empty catch blocks and log-and-continue patterns.
2. Decide per site: propagate, wrap with context, or handle with an explanatory comment.
3. Never catch Throwable blindly; preserve interrupts.
4. Rebuild with javac.exec; summarize each decision.

skills.name: Java build wiring
skills.description: Fix dependency and build configuration issues.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read build.gradle.kts or pom.xml.
2. Check versions against the actual code requirements; align mismatches.
3. Patch the build file; run gradle.exec to verify resolution.
4. Report the dependency graph changes in one table.

skills.name: Node.js scripting
skills.description: Run JavaScript tooling with the bundled Node runtime.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Write the script with file.write; use CommonJS or ESM consistently.
2. Execute with node.exec; capture and show output.
3. Iterate with file.patch on errors.
4. Keep scripts in the workspace; clean up after.

skills.name: npm workflow
skills.description: Install and manage npm packages correctly.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Check package.json with file.read before any npm.exec install.
2. Pin versions; avoid floating ranges in committed files.
3. Run npm.exec with the exact package specs.
4. Verify the app still runs with node.exec.

skills.name: TypeScript strictness
skills.description: Enable and satisfy strict TypeScript checks.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read tsconfig.json; note current strictness flags.
2. Fix type errors smallest-first with file.patch; prefer precise types over any.
3. Re-run the type check via node.exec after each batch.
4. Report remaining suppressions with reasons.

skills.name: JS async correctness
skills.description: Avoid promise pitfalls in Node scripts.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read the async code; mark fire-and-forget calls.
2. Convert sequential awaits that could be parallel with Promise.all where order allows.
3. Add try/catch at the top level of scripts with non-zero exit codes on failure.
4. Run with node.exec and verify output ordering.

skills.name: Jest testing
skills.description: Write and run Jest tests for JS modules.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.list the test folder; match existing style.
2. Test one behavior per case; mock external I/O.
3. Keep assertions specific; no truthy-only checks.
4. Run via npm.exec test or node.exec; report counts.

skills.name: C for embedded-style code
skills.description: Write bounded, allocation-free C where it matters.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read the target module to match its memory model.
2. Prefer fixed buffers with explicit sizes; document bounds.
3. Check every return value; fail loudly.
4. Compile with clang.exec and fix warnings until clean.

skills.name: Makefile work
skills.description: Debug and extend Make-based builds.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read the Makefile; trace the failing target chain.
2. Fix dependencies and flags minimally.
3. Run make.exec for the specific target; capture output.
4. Verify the produced artifacts exist and run.

skills.name: Modern C++ practice
skills.description: Use RAII and standard algorithms instead of manual memory.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read the code; find new/delete and raw owning pointers.
2. Replace with smart pointers and containers; keep ABI in mind for exported APIs.
3. Compile with clang.exec with warnings enabled; resolve them.
4. Run the relevant tests or a smoke main.

skills.name: CMake basics
skills.description: Configure and fix CMake builds.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read CMakeLists.txt; identify targets and options.
2. Fix source lists and flags minimally.
3. Configure and build via make.exec as available.
4. Verify produced binaries with a short run.

skills.name: PHP scripting
skills.description: Run PHP utilities with the bundled runtime.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Write the script with file.write; declare strict types.
2. Run with php.exec; show output.
3. Fix errors iteratively with file.patch.
4. Keep scripts tidy in the workspace; remove when done.

skills.name: Composer dependency work
skills.description: Manage PHP packages with Composer.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read composer.json; note required extensions and versions.
2. Run composer.exec require or update with exact constraints.
3. Verify the autoloader with a small php.exec script.
4. Summarize added packages and version changes.

skills.name: Ruby scripting
skills.description: Run Ruby utilities with the bundled runtime.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Write the script with file.write; use frozen string literals.
2. Run with ruby.exec; capture output.
3. Iterate with file.patch.
4. Clean up scratch files after.

skills.name: Shell pipelines
skills.description: Compose robust shell one-liners via process.exec.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Prefer small pipelines over long scripts; quote everything.
2. Test on a tiny subset before running on the full input.
3. Use strict mode flags in multi-line scripts.
4. Show the exact command you ran and its exit code.

skills.name: find and xargs mastery
skills.description: Bulk file operations done safely.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Start with a read-only find via process.exec and review the list.
2. Only then add exec or xargs; verify counts first.
3. Never glob into system directories; stay in the workspace.
4. Report how many files each stage processed.

skills.name: sed and awk editing
skills.description: Deterministic text edits via command line.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Preview the transformation on a sample with process.exec.
2. Apply in-place only after the preview matches expectations.
3. Keep a .bak copy for the first run on each file.
4. Verify with a diff before cleanup.
